added: Digital Master Test (dMAT) Status Update: Upcoming Test Sessions and Registration
The dMAT is an additional element in the APS documentation for selected Master’s applicants.

Following the completion of the first dMAT session, the next test cycles are scheduled for mid-January and mid-March. These test sessions are particularly relevant for applicants aiming to begin their Master’s studies in Germany in the winter semester 2027/28.

Details regarding the updated list of affected fields of study, as well as the registration start date, will be announced on this website shortly. For applicants in these specified fields, the dMAT is a mandatory requirement for obtaining an APS certificate.

Reminder: Master’s applicants in affected fields may continue to submit their complete APS application documents in advance. Verification will begin upon receipt, and the final APS certificate will be issued once the dMAT score report has been verified.
removed: Submit your APS documents before your dMAT certificate is available

The dMAT is an additional element in the APS documentation for selected Master’s applicants whose previous degree falls within Engineering, Commerce / Accounting / Finance / Economics, or Business / Management.

Applicants in the affected subject groups for the Summer Semester 2027 Master intake or later Master intakes may submit their complete APS application documents now, before the dMAT certificate is available. APS India can begin the document verification in advance.

The APS certificate can only be issued after the required dMAT certificate has been submitted and checked. All other documents required by the applicable APS checklist must be included in the initial submission.
